title: BizFlood Rate Manual — Rates per 100, Flood Zone Factors, Multi-Location Credit and Minimum Premiums
content:
Tidemark's written rating figures for BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) are the annual rates per 100 USD of limit, the rating factor for each FEMA flood zone of a location, the multi-location credit with the location count above which it applies, and the lowest annual premium of the policy before fees and taxes.

## Table A — Annual rates per 100 USD of limit

| Tier | Building | Business personal property (contents) | Business income |
|---|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | 0.62 | 0 | 0 |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | 0.62 | 0.71 | 0 |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | 0.62 | 0.71 | 0.38 |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | 0.41 | 0.48 | 0.38 |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | 0.62 | 0.71 | 0.38 |
| BizFlood Large Property | 0.55 | 0.64 | 0.33 |

A rate of 0 stands against a coverage the tier does not write.

## Table B — Flood zone factors (identical on all six tiers)

| FEMA flood zone of the location | Factor |
|---|---|
| X, B, C | 0.3 |
| A99, AR | 0.6 |
| AO | 0.95 |
| A, AE, AH | 1.0 |
| D | 1.15 |
| V, VE | 2.6 |

## Table C — Multi-location credit and minimum premium

| Tier | Multi-location credit (percent of the total premium) | Applies when locations scheduled are above | Minimum annual premium before fees and taxes (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | 0 | 0 | 1500 |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | 0 | 0 | 2000 |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | 0 | 0 | 2750 |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | 0 | 0 | 1750 |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | 7.5 | 5 | 5000 |
| BizFlood Large Property | 10 | 5 | 25000 |

## Notes to the tables

- The credit threshold is a strict "above": on BizFlood Multi-Location and BizFlood Large Property the credit is earned by 6 or more scheduled locations, and a schedule of exactly 5 locations earns none.
- On the four single-location tiers the credit percentage is 0, so no credit reduces the premium there.
- BizFlood Excess over NFIP carries lower building and contents rates than the primary single-location tiers: 0.41 and 0.48 against 0.62 and 0.71.

## Lookup illustration (hypothetical location)

A hypothetical location in zone AE on BizFlood Building and Contents reads a building rate of 0.62, a contents rate of 0.71 and a zone factor of 1.0; the same location moved to zone X reads a zone factor of 0.3 with the same two rates.
